arunachal_educational_architecture.state_elementary_board: APSBE conducts the official Arunachal Pradesh State Board Examination for Classes V and VIII across all government and designated recognized schools in the state.
arunachal_educational_architecture.secondary_senior_secondary_pathway: Secondary (Class 10) and Higher Secondary (Class 12) education in Arunachal Pradesh state government and recognized private schools is affiliated with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE), New Delhi. Examinations are conducted under CBSE AISSE (Class 10) and AISSCE (Class 12). Select institutions follow CISCE or NIOS.
arunachal_educational_architecture.state_board_scope_distinction: APSBE is NOT a Class 10 or Class 12 examination board. APSBE currently covers Class V and Class VIII only. Zero fake Class 10 or Class 12 board examinations are administered by APSBE.

external_higher_education_authorities.class_10: CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education - AISSE)
external_higher_education_authorities.class_12: CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education - AISSCE)

class_11.pathway: Internal institutional evaluation following CBSE +2 curriculum

class_12.exam_name: CBSE All India Senior School Certificate Examination (AISSCE)
class_12.audit_note: APSBE does not conduct Class 12 board examinations. Arunachal schools are affiliated with CBSE.
